answer: Per-identity wear toll: each agent's counter ticks every pulse, and its per-block fee equals base × (1 + counter × n), n being identities the same controller holds. Basalt rule: a new identity inherits the max counter across all held ones, so its first block already pays top tier. An attacker parking 500 IDs on one jetty of capital faces per-block drain ≈ 500 × counter × base, making marginal creation unbounded.
